notes: 介面與玩法文字（出身、環島傳送、操作說明、小遊戲、提示）。由 src/core/content.ts 在載入時檢查格式。{name}、{n} 為代入欄位。

origins.hint: 西岸返鄉／尋根，開元港就在家門口。
origins.hintEn: West coast, coming home / finding roots, with Kaiyuan Harbour on the doorstep.

origins.hint: 北岸開闊海岸，分上、下部落與潮間帶。
origins.hintEn: The open north coast, with upper and lower villages and tide flats.

origins.hint: 東北岸東清灣，迎接島上第一道曙光。
origins.hintEn: Dongqing Bay on the northeast coast, greeting the island's first light.

origins.hint: 東南岸，最完整的傳統地下屋聚落。
origins.hintEn: Southeast coast, the most complete village of traditional underground houses.

origins.hint: 南岸，飛魚傳說起源；衛生所在此。
origins.hintEn: South coast, where the flying fish legend began; the health station is here.

origins.hint: 西南平坦之地，蘭嶼機場就在部落旁。
origins.hintEn: Flat land in the southwest, with Lanyu Airport right next to the village.

origins.hint: 自開元港上岸。先看、先聽、先問，再走近舟與屋。
origins.hintEn: Arriving at Kaiyuan Harbour. Look first, listen first, ask first — then go near the boats and houses.

origins.hint: 交給海風決定這趟旅程的起點。
origins.hintEn: Let the sea wind decide where this journey starts.

toastTouchEn: One finger to turn the view

touch.title: 移動與機車
touch.body: 左下方滑動即可移動。點右下「選單」裡的「步行｜機車」可騎上電動機車，騎在公路上會自動沿著路走，往旁邊推就能離開；環島公路較快，田埂與碼頭會自動放慢。
touch.bodyEn: Swipe bottom-left to move. Open "Menu" at the bottom right and tap "Walk | Scooter" to ride the e-scooter. On a road it follows the road by itself; push sideways to turn off it. The round-island road is faster; field banks and docks slow you down automatically.

touch.title: 視角縮放
touch.body: 單指拖曳轉視角，雙指開合縮放。進出部落時鏡頭會自動拉近、拉遠。右下「選單」可重置視角、微調遠近，或關掉導引箭頭。
touch.bodyEn: Drag one finger to turn the view, pinch with two to zoom. The camera moves in when you enter a village and back out when you leave. "Menu" at the bottom right resets or adjusts the view, or turns the guide arrow off.

touch.title: 互動與手札
touch.body: 靠近人物或地點後，點畫面提示或右下「互動」。附近的人或可以採的東西，直接點一下，大家就會走過去交談或採集。右上角打開圖鑑手札；點小地圖可環島傳送。
touch.bodyEn: Get close to a person or place, then tap the prompt or "Interact" at the bottom right. Tap someone or something to gather nearby and the party walks over to talk or gather. Open the notebook at the top right; tap the minimap to travel around the island.

touch.title: 隊伍與任務
touch.body: 左上角三個頭像是族男、族女和旅人，點一下就換人操控，其他人會跟在後面。點任務條或右上角手札的「任務」頁，查看進行中、已完成和還沒解鎖的任務。
touch.bodyEn: The three portraits at the top left are the Tao man, the Tao woman and the traveller. Tap one to switch who you control; the others follow. Tap the quest bar or the "Quests" page in the notebook (top right) to see active, finished and locked quests.

desktop.title: 移動與機車
desktop.body: WASD 或方向鍵移動，方向跟著畫面。按 M 或在右下「選單」點「步行｜機車」切換電動機車；騎在公路上會自動沿著路走，往旁邊按就能離開。環島公路較快，田埂與碼頭會自動放慢。
desktop.bodyEn: WASD or arrow keys to move; directions follow the screen. Press M or open "Menu" at the bottom right and tap "Walk | Scooter" to switch to the e-scooter. On a road it follows the road by itself; steer sideways to turn off it. The round-island road is faster; field banks and docks slow you down automatically.

desktop.title: 視角縮放
desktop.body: 拖曳畫面或按 Q／R 旋轉視角，滾輪縮放。進出部落時鏡頭會自動拉近、拉遠。右下「選單」可重置視角、微調遠近，或關掉導引箭頭。
desktop.bodyEn: Drag the screen or press Q / R to turn the view; scroll to zoom. The camera moves in when you enter a village and back out when you leave. "Menu" at the bottom right resets or adjusts the view, or turns the guide arrow off.

desktop.title: 互動與手札
desktop.body: 靠近後按 E（或 F、空白鍵），或點畫面提示。附近的人或可以採的東西，用滑鼠點一下就會走過去交談或採集。按 J 或右上角打開圖鑑手札；點小地圖可環島傳送。
desktop.bodyEn: When close, press E (or F, Space), or tap the prompt. Click someone or something to gather nearby to walk over and talk or gather. Press J or tap the top right to open the notebook; tap the minimap to travel around the island.

desktop.title: 隊伍與任務
desktop.body: 按 1／2／3 或點左上角頭像切換族男、族女、旅人；按 C 輪流切換。按 L 打開任務頁。進度會自動存在這台裝置的瀏覽器裡。
desktop.bodyEn: Press 1 / 2 / 3 or tap a portrait at the top left to switch between the Tao man, Tao woman and traveller; press C to cycle. Press L for the quests page. Progress saves automatically in this device's browser.

taro.title: 採收水芋  soli
taro.desc: 看準綠色區間按下「把握時機」。這是教學田，請不要走進別人的田埂。
taro.descEn: Tap "Now!" when the marker is in the green zone. This is a teaching field — please don't walk on other people's field banks.

milestone.title: 初收水芋
milestone.bodyEn: soli was added to your notebook.

success.title: 採收成功
success.body: 水芋 soli 收入傳統食材。

fail.title: 再試一次
fail.body: 節奏偏了，水還很涼，再靠近田埂看看。
fail.bodyEn: The rhythm was off. The water's still cool — get closer to the field bank and try again.

fish.title: 飛魚躍出  alibangbang
fish.desc: 看準飛魚躍出的時機。這只是港口體驗點，不是漁團的火把招魚。
fish.descEn: Catch the moment a flying fish leaps. This is just a practice spot at the harbour, not a crew's torch fishing.

milestone.title: 飛魚季的海
milestone.titleEn: The sea in flying fish season
milestone.bodyEn: alibangbang was added to your notebook.

success.title: 時機剛好
success.body: 飛魚 alibangbang 收入傳統食材。
success.bodyEn: Flying fish (alibangbang) added to traditional foods.

fail.title: 再試一次
fail.body: 飛魚已經落下水面，等下一躍。
fail.bodyEn: The flying fish has dropped back into the water. Wait for the next leap.

text.startTitleEn: Set foot on Pongso no Tao
text.startBody: 里程碑記進手札了。按 J 或點右上角就能翻開看。
text.startBodyEn: Milestone saved in your notebook. Press J or tap the top right to have a look.
text.startErrorBody: 開場出了點問題，重新整理一下再試試看。
text.startErrorBodyEn: Something went wrong at the start. Refresh the page and give it another go.
text.allTimesBody: 你看過清晨、白天、黃昏與夜晚。
text.allTimesBodyEn: You've seen dawn, day, dusk and night.
text.allSeasonsBody: 招魚祭、飛魚季、終食祭與休漁期都走過了。
text.allSeasonsBodyEn: You've been through the fish-calling festival, flying fish season, end-of-eating festival and the off-season.
text.placeHint: 在部落廣場走走，找長輩或涼亭旁的人聊聊吧。
text.placeHintEn: Wander around the village square and have a chat with an elder or the people by the pavilion.
text.fallbackLine: （他們微笑點頭，暫時沒有要多說。）
text.fallbackLineEn: (They smile and nod, and don't say more for now.)
text.scooterOnBody: 在環島公路上快很多；到了水芋田埂和碼頭會自己放慢。按 M 或點「步行｜機車」就能換。
text.scooterOnBodyEn: Much quicker on the round-island road; it slows down by itself on taro field banks and docks. Press M or tap "Walk | Scooter" to switch.
text.scooterOffBody: 現在用走的。想再騎，按 M 或再點一次「步行｜機車」。
text.scooterOffBodyEn: On foot now. Want to ride again? Press M or tap "Walk | Scooter" once more.
text.travelBody: 到了！還想去別的地方，就騎機車沿著環島公路走。
text.travelBodyEn: You're here! Hop on the scooter and follow the round-island road to keep exploring.
